verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair axis for a SaaS app builder like Bolt.new, but the evidence documents only UI workflows: chat, code view, visual edits, multiplayer and publishing. It shows no public API for driving projects programmatically, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The GitHub sync and MCP connectors let Bolt reach out to other services rather than exposing Bolt itself through an API, so they don't count toward this story.
